```sql
SELECT 
    CAST(
        COALESCE(pos_rev, 0) + COALESCE(ecom_rev, 0) + COALESCE(erp_rev, 0) 
        AS DECIMAL(18, 4)
    ) AS answer
FROM 
    (
        -- 1. POS Revenue for NZ in May 2025
        SELECT SUM(l.line_total) AS pos_rev
        FROM staging.stg_pos__transaction_lines l
        JOIN staging.stg_erp__stores s ON l.store_id = s.store_id
        WHERE s.country = 'New Zealand'
          AND l.txn_date >= '2025-05-01' AND l.txn_date <= '2025-05-31'
          AND l.is_valid = TRUE
    ) p
    CROSS JOIN (
        -- 2. E-commerce Revenue for NZ in May 2025 (Completed/Valid orders, net of refunds/discounts represented in line totals)
        -- Note: Excludes shipping fees and cancelled web orders as per business definition for net revenue.
        SELECT SUM(l.line_total) AS ecom_rev
        FROM staging.stg_ecom__order_lines l
        JOIN staging.stg_ecom__orders o ON l.order_id = o.order_id
        WHERE o.region_code IN (
            SELECT region_code FROM reference.regions WHERE country = 'New Zealand'
        )
        AND o.order_date >= '2025-05-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-05-31'
        AND o.order_status != 'cancelled'
    ) e
    CROSS JOIN (
        -- 3. Wholesale (ERP) Revenue for NZ in May 2025, handling AUD to NZD conversion if applicable
        SELECT SUM(
            CASE 
                WHEN sol.currency = 'AUD' THEN sol.net_value * COALESCE(fx.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
                ELSE sol.net_value
            END
        ) AS erp_rev
        FROM staging.stg_erp__sales_order_lines sol
        JOIN staging.stg_erp__customers c ON sol.customer_id = c.customer_id
        LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__fx_rates fx ON sol.order_date = fx.rate_date
        WHERE c.country = 'New Zealand'
          AND sol.order_date >= '2025-05-01' AND sol.order_date <= '2025-05-31'
    ) erp;
```
